transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling incredibly depressed and sad for about ten months now. I just feel completely empty inside, and I've lost all motivation to do anything. It's really hard to even get through the day.

Have you felt this low mood almost every single day for the past ten months without any periods of feeling back to your normal self, or have there been times where you felt better for more than two months?
Yes, it has been constant for the entire ten months. I haven't had any periods where I felt like my normal self or felt any better at all. It's just been a continuous, heavy emptiness the whole time.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were Major Depressive Disorder and Persistent Depressive Disorder. The patient reports a continuous, unremitting low mood lasting for ten months without any symptom-free intervals of two months or more. This duration and persistence are consistent with the diagnostic criteria for Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia).
